name: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Clark
short_description: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Clark is a half-marathon event held on August 30, 2026, at Filinvest Mimosa in Clark, Philippines.
ai_summary: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Clark is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 30, 2026, at Filinvest Mimosa in Clark, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the EastWest Dream Run brand, the event offers multiple distance options including 21, 10, 5, 3, and 1 kilometers, with the half-marathon (21.1km) as the primary distance. Registration has not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (21, 10, 5, 3, and 1 km) accommodate a range of runner abilities.
Organized by Runrio, an established name behind the EastWest Dream Run brand.
Set at Filinvest Mimosa, a dedicated venue in Clark, Philippines.
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are currently unavailable.
research_highlights: The Clark leg takes place at Filinvest Mimosa Plus Events Grounds, Clark Avenue, Angeles, Pampanga on August 30, 2026, with distance options of 1K, 3K, 5K, 10K and 21K.
This is the second edition of the event, following an inaugural 2025 EastWest Dream Run that drew around 14,000 runners nationwide.
The Clark leg is organized by Runrio in partnership with EastWest Bank, and Quest Plus Conference Center Clark is listed as the event's hotel partner.
The race village includes cooling zones, a recovery lounge, and sponsor activations (based on the format used for the Manila leg of the same 2026 series).
research_watchouts: The Clark leg date has been changed at least once by organizers (originally floated for May 24, 2026, then moved to August 30, 2026), so registrants should double-check the current schedule before travel/lodging plans.

As of this search, no independent participant reviews or race reports for the Clark leg were found — all available coverage is organizer/press-release material, and a race-listing aggregator (World's Marathons) explicitly shows 'No reviews yet' for this event.
